_note: Example data modeled on a payment status lifecycle. Replace labels, API values, and descriptions with the client's real definitions before publishing.
title: Payment status lifecycle
summary: Every payment has a status and a more specific substatus. Select a status to see what it means and where it can move next.

groups.label: Created
groups.description: The payment object exists but no payment method is attached yet.

groups.label: Ready to pay
groups.description: A payment method is attached and the payment can be submitted.

groups.label: Verified
groups.description: The payment data passed validation and is sent for processing.

groups.label: Expired
groups.description: The payment was not completed before its expiration time. Create a new payment to try again.

groups.label: Pending
groups.description: The payment is being processed. Check the substatus to know what it is waiting for.

states.label: In process
states.description: The provider is processing the payment.

states.label: Authorized
states.description: Funds are reserved and waiting for capture.

states.label: Waiting additional step
states.description: The customer must complete an extra step, such as 3D Secure authentication.

states.label: Pending provider confirmation
states.description: Waiting for the provider to confirm the result.

states.label: Pending fraud review
states.description: The payment is under fraud analysis.

groups.label: Rejected / declined
groups.description: The payment was not approved. The substatus tells you who refused it.

states.label: Rejected
states.description: Refused by validation rules before reaching the provider.

states.label: Declined
states.description: Refused by the issuer or provider.

states.label: Fraud declined
states.description: Refused by fraud screening.

states.label: Fraud screening verified
states.description: Fraud checks completed without findings.

groups.label: Cancelled
groups.description: The payment was cancelled before completion.

states.label: Pending provider confirmation
states.description: Cancellation requested, waiting for provider confirmation.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: Cancellation confirmed.

groups.label: Succeeded
groups.description: The payment was approved. The substatus shows capture, refund, and chargeback progress.

states.label: Partially approved
states.description: Only part of the requested amount was approved.

states.label: Approved
states.description: The full amount was approved.

states.label: Partially captured
states.description: Part of the approved amount was captured.

states.label: Captured
states.description: The full amount was captured.

states.label: Partially refunded
states.description: Part of the captured amount was refunded.

states.label: Partially chargebacked
states.description: Part of the amount was reversed by a chargeback.

groups.label: In dispute
groups.description: The cardholder disputed the payment. Submit evidence before the deadline.

states.label: Received
states.description: The dispute was opened.

states.label: Pending review
states.description: Evidence was submitted and is under review.

groups.label: Chargeback
groups.description: The dispute was lost and the amount was reversed.

states.label: Lost
states.description: The dispute decision went to the cardholder.

groups.label: Refunded
groups.description: The full amount was returned to the customer.

states.label: Pending provider confirmation
states.description: Refund requested, waiting for provider confirmation.

states.label: Refunded
states.description: Refund confirmed.

global.label: Error
global.description: Can happen at any point in the flow. The substatus explains the error.
